label: Black Scarab estimated compensation
basis: advertised annual salary excluding bonus and equity
method: Median of one eligible annual USD salary-range midpoint per distinct requisition.
eligibility: Technical engineering roles owning physical component/assembly test equipment, instrumentation, validation, production test or diagnostics. Senior/staff individual contributors included.
limitations: Purposive U.S. sample is concentrated in experienced manufacturing/electrical-test positions at four employers, including two Boston Dynamics and two Skydio requisitions. Not an entry-level rate or representative market median. Core prototype and mechanical roles without an explicitly annual pay period do not contribute. Structured salary fields do not consistently establish base pay.

observations.sourceClause: Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan.
